Question: Triangle \(ABC\) lies in the first quadrant. Points \(A,\) \(B,\) and \(C\) are reflected across the line \(y=x\) to points \(A',\) \(B',\) and \(C',\) respectively. Assume that none of the vertices of the triangle lie on the line \(y=x.\) Which of the following statements is not always true?

Choices.A: Triangle \(A'B'C'\) lies in the first quadrant.
Choices.B: Triangles \(ABC\) and \(A'B'C'\) have the same area.
Choices.D: The slopes of lines \(AA'\) and \(CC'\) are the same.
Choices.E:
Lines \(AB\) and \(A'B'\) are perpendicular to
each other.
